events.verdict: Herro (MIA) does not establish the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Herro (MIA) places his off-arm against McBride (NYK) and releases from contact as he steps back.
Adebayo (MIA) moves into Anunoby's (NYK) lower body and initiates illegal contact prior to him controlling the pass. Therefore, it is correctly deemed a non-shooting foul.
Mitchell (MIA) reaches in, but the contact with Brunson's (NYK) side is marginal and does not affect his shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Hart (NYK) maintains his pivot foot prior to making the pass.
Ware (MIA) initiates illegal contact to Anunoby's (NYK) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
McBride (NYK) briefly places a hand to Mitchell's (MIA) front before immediately removing it. After correcting, he then legally contests Mitchell's driving shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Adebayo's (MIA) possession and any ensuing contact once the ball is loose is incidental.
Highsmith (MIA) steps laterally into Brunson's (NYK) path on the drive as he is gathering the ball in the lower defensive box.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Highsmith (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Brunson (NYK) commits a foul proximate to the play when he clamps and holds Highsmith's arm, affecting his ability to control the rebound. Play resumes with Miami possession.
Burks (MIA) places a forearm against Anunoby (NYK), but does not affect his dunk attempt.
